notes.title: Demo Available Now
notes.content:
[h3][b]Experience the Thrill of Planetary Strike[/b][/h3]

Prepare for a chess-like spacefaring adventure. We are excited to announce the launch of the [b]Planetary Strike Demo[/b], now available for download on Steam! 

[h3][b]Command a Fleet[/b][/h3] As a Commander, guide your fleet through intense space battles against formidable opponents, showcasing your strategic prowess and tactical skills.

[h3][b]Unveil The Story[/b][/h3] Immerse yourself in a gripping single-player campaign with a visual novel like story. Explore the galaxy and meet interesting characters.

[h3][b]Make Choices That Matter[/b][/h3] Shape the course of your journey by making choices that truly alter the trajectory of the narrative.

[b][h2]Download and play the demo today![/h2][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2604720/Planetary_Strike_Demo?snr=1_7_15__13


We appreciate your support and feedback as we continue to refine and enhance Planetary Strike for its full-fledged release! We hope you enjoy the demo.

- Claim to Fame Games
